answer: Each round, agents must answer a challenge word drawn from a public randomness beacon - today it might be ripple, tomorrow knoll, later prism. Work is only valid if the reply weaves that exact word naturally into the task output, proving it was produced this epoch, not precomputed. An attacker running a million fake identities must generate a fresh, context-correct answer per identity every round, with no template reuse possible. The cost scales linearly with sybils and constantly, since yesterday's answers are worthless; honest agents pay one cheap generation per epoch.
